mapper.sql: T.TEACHER_NO, T.EMPID, T.PERSON_ID, T.TEACHER_NAME, (SELECT GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS ORG_NAME_LOCAL, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS POST_GRADE_NO_NAME, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = T.PERSON_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS POSITION_NO_NAME, T.TEACH_FIELD_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TEACH_FIELD_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TEACH_FIELD_CODE_NAME, T.TEACH_LEVEL_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TEACH_LEVEL_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TEACH_LEVEL_CODE_NAME, T.TEACH_STATUS_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T.TEACH_STATUS_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TEACH_STATUS_CODE_NAME, TO_CHAR(T.HIRE_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS HIRE_TIME, TO_CHAR(T.FIRING_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS FIRING_TIME, T.BUSINESS_ACT_TIME, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL((SYSDATE - T.HIRE_TIME) / 30, 0) + NVL(TO_NUMBER(T.BUSINESS_ACT_TIME), 0))) AS ALLTIME, T.REMARK
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_TEACHER_MANAGER ( TEACHER_NO, TEACH_FIELD_CODE, TEACH_LEVEL_CODE, HIRE_TIME, FIRING_TIME, TEACH_STATUS_CODE, BUSINESS_ACT_TIME, REMARK, EMPID, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, PERSON_ID, TEACHER_NAME ) VALUES ( #{teacherNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teachFieldCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teachLevelCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{hireTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{firingTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{teachStatusCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{businessActTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{teacherName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_TEACHER_MANAGER SET TEACH_FIELD_CODE = #{teachFieldCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TEACH_LEVEL_CODE = #{teachLevelCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HIRE_TIME = TO_DATE(#{hireTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), FIRING_TIME = TO_DATE(#{firingTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TEACH_STATUS_CODE = #{teachStatusCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE TEACHER_NO = #{teacherNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
